title: Shatterbelt journeys
description: Players' experience of Shatterbelt, as its README describes it to them.

entities.name: Climb the high-score table
entities.description: A player flies alone, names themselves on the table and comes back to see it.
entities.goal: Get a name onto the public table, higher than before.

stages.context: Arrives at the game signed out.
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.
stages.outcome: The title screen over a drifting belt, with the best pilots beside how to play.

stages.action: Breaks rocks wave after wave, chases pods and drones, and keeps a streak going, until every ship is lost.
stages.outcome: A score and the wave reached; a new ship every 10,000 points along the way.

stages.context: The game is over and the score makes a table.
stages.touchpoint: The name form over the screen
stages.action: Types a name of up to 12 letters or digits and saves.
stages.outcome: The score with its rank among all pilots, checked by replay.
The table, for anyone to see, with each pilot's wave and kind of game.

entities.name: Fly with friends online
entities.description: Friends, each on their own device, meet in the multiplayer lobby and play one game together or against each other.

sources.symbol: Playing online: each pilot on their own computer

entities.goal: Play friends who are somewhere else, in co-op or versus, and see everyone on the table.

stages.context: Everyone is signed in to the games.
stages.action: One starts a Shatterbelt co-op or versus game and waits; the others join by typing that player's address.
stages.outcome: A 60-second countdown, started again whenever someone joins and cut short when everyone presses Ready.

sources.symbol: Playing online: each pilot on their own computer

stages.context: The game opens on every device, two to nine of them.
stages.action: Each flies their own ship; the line under the field says which pilot they are, in their colour.
stages.outcome: The same game on every screen; a slow connection makes the others wait, and they are told. A pilot who leaves stays in the game with an idle ship.

sources.symbol: Playing online: each pilot on their own computer

stages.touchpoint: The name form, on each pilot's own screen
stages.action: Each pilot who made the table names themselves.
stages.outcome: The host's browser sends the game with every name; everyone sees the ranks.

sources.symbol: Playing online: each pilot on their own computer

stages.outcome: The lobby, ready for another game.
